name: AllTrade Recycling Ltd
summary: AllTrade Recycling Ltd engages in collection, treatment, and recycling service of computer and electronic equipment. The company offers services, such as recycling of electronic waste, planning and construction of recycling plants, engineering consulting, recycling of non-ferrous metals, IT asset disposal, dismantling of factories and infrastructure, destruction of information components, cable recycling, battery recycling, and recycling of cooling and heating products, as well as offers engineering consulting and support to various recycling companies. AllTrade Recycling Ltd was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel.
